title: Protocol-debt record — v1.0
description: plan.md §5.3, gate table row G15. A non-pairwise interaction (protocol_class: non-pairwise) requires an external protocol artifact or a protocol-debt record -- this is the latter: a reviewed out-of-scope declaration. plan.md is explicit it 'suffices only when all five hold': no promoted obligation depends on the protocol, no work package touches its path, no release claim includes it, a human signed the scope cut, and a tracking issue records the missing support. The first three are facts about promoted/external state this schema cannot itself verify (that cross-reference is G15's job, out of scope here, the same boundary chainlink #16 drew for R2/exemptions) -- they are represented as const:true attestation fields so a record can never be filed admitting one is false; the last two are directly enforced (review, tracking_issue). One per crates/*/specs/_protocol_debt/<interaction_id>.json, naming the non-pairwise interaction it covers. Carries its own review block and never a promotion_id (references are one-way, plan.md §7.1) -- mirrors docs/exemption-schema.json's shape, but a normal boundary exemption is never sufficient for a temporal/protocol obligation (plan.md §5.3), so this is a distinct artifact type, not a reuse of exemptions.

interaction_id.description: The non-pairwise interaction this scope cut covers. Must equal the filename stem exactly (G1b, enforced by scripts/validate_protocol_debt.py) -- one debt record per interaction, same discipline as boundary_id.

no_promoted_obligation_depends_on_protoc.description: plan.md §5.3, condition 1. Attestation only -- not independently re-verified against promoted state by this schema.

no_work_package_touches_its_path.description: plan.md §5.3, condition 2. Attestation only -- not independently re-verified against work-package manifests by this schema.

no_release_claim_includes_it.description: plan.md §5.3, condition 3. Attestation only -- not independently re-verified by this schema (no release-claim artifact exists yet in this codebase).

tracking_issue.description: plan.md §5.3, condition 5: 'a tracking issue records the missing support.'
